description: This Java class 'RocksDBCalculatedFieldStateService' extends 'AbstractCalculatedFieldStateService' and manages calculated field states using RocksDB. It includes methods for initialization, persistence, removal, and restoration of state data, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: RocksDBCalculatedFieldStateService
classes.description: A service class that manages calculated field states using RocksDB, including persistence, removal, and restoration of state data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the state service with a partitioned queue consumer manager.

methods.name: doPersist
methods.description: Persists the calculated field state into RocksDB.

methods.name: doRemove
methods.description: Removes the calculated field state from RocksDB.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores state from RocksDB into the service, parsing stored data and handling errors.
